entries.en: Added deprecation notification for npm installations - run `claude install` or see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup for more options
entries.zh: 添加了 npm 安装的弃用通知 - 运行 `claude install` 或参阅 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup 了解更多选项

entries.en: Improved UI rendering performance with React Compiler
entries.zh: 借助 React Compiler 提升界面渲染性能

entries.en: Fixed the "Context left until auto-compact" warning not disappearing after running `/compact`
entries.zh: 修复了运行`/compact`后“上下文剩余直至自动压缩”警告不消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP stdio server timeout not killing child process, which could cause UI freezes
entries.zh: 修复了 MCP stdio 服务器超时未终止子进程，这可能导致 UI 冻结的问题
